auth_details: Bearer access token in Authorization header (OAuth 2.0 or personal access token). Sandbox uses sandbox tokens against connect.squareupsandbox.com. Square-Version header is recommended to pin the API version; if omitted, the application's configured default version is used.
free_tier_limits: API and SDK access is free; standard US online payment processing is currently 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction (other methods, countries, and volume agreements differ); no free transaction-fee tier for card processing
resolution_notes: auth.details: Auditor correct. Official docs state Square-Version is optional and overrides the app's default API version when set (https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/versioning-overview). free_tier_limits: Auditor correct on US online rate. Square Pricing lists online/eCommerce API card processing at 2.9% + 30¢ (not ~2.6% + 10¢) (https://squareup.com/us/en/pricing, https://squareup.com/us/en/payments/online-card-payment-processing).
